subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this custom cooperative glob walker and bootstrap-only inter-handler yielding as the permanent shared runtime behavior?
rationale: No contributor-facing defect remains, but the patch replaces shared context-selection and scheduling contracts whose long-term compatibility cannot be decided from focused tests alone.

options.title: Approve current design
options.body: Accept the tested glob-parity rules and bootstrap-only yielding because they remove the observed stall without changing public plugin SDK signatures.

options.title: Request a narrower fix
options.body: Retain asynchronous root file reads but defer either the custom glob implementation or hook scheduling until a different shared abstraction is selected.

recommendation.title: Approve current design
recommendation.body: Accept the tested glob-parity rules and bootstrap-only yielding because they remove the observed stall without changing public plugin SDK signatures.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most heavily maintained the affected bootstrap resolution and internal-hook contracts.
